description:
CLEANUP. After fz-1m2.2, the boxed machinery for Typed callables is dead. Remove it; do not leave scaffolding.

WHAT STAYS: closure-value boxing (publication seams box published_value_lane -- a closure is a heap pointer; correct for both conventions). The boxed wrapper + boxed_first_class override + boxed dispatch all remain for genuinely Boxed callables (heterogeneous arms, opaque escape) -- legitimate ABI bridge, not a shim.

RIP OUT (verify orphaned via rg, then delete):
- Boxed wrapper (callable_boundary_b) emission for Typed callables (declare/emit only for Boxed).
- Any boxed_first_class / boundary_escapes_into_fz_space remnants left after fz-1m2.2.
- The fault-3 positional return-grounding helpers in transport (boundary_return_shapes_for_publication_sources and friends) IF the convention's grounded resolution return makes them redundant for Boxed too -- re-verify; keep only what genuine Boxed callables still need.
- Confirm retain_most_specific_surfaces (fz-rh2.29.7) now lives at its canonical home as the convention classifier's input (fz-1m2.1); collapse any duplication.

CHECK: rg confirms each deleted construct has zero remaining callers; full lib + matrix green; zero warnings; behavior identical to end of fz-1m2.2.
title: Rip out the dead boxed-first-class path and orphaned compensations
